quests.passage: Software capable of generating an entire song, complete with melody and lyrics, in a specific artist's recognizable style has raised copyright questions that existing law was never designed to address. Determining whether such a song infringes on an original artist's rights becomes complicated when no specific melody is directly copied, only a general style, something copyright law has traditionally struggled to protect on its own. Some artists have pursued legal action against these tools regardless, arguing that training software on their body of work without permission constitutes a different kind of infringement entirely. Courts and lawmakers in several countries are actively working through these unresolved questions, with no clear consensus yet in sight.
options: How AI Music Generation Software Works
The History of Music Copyright Law
The Unresolved Copyright Questions of AI-Made Music
The General Impact of AI on the Music Industry
quests.correctAnswer: The Unresolved Copyright Questions of AI-Made Music
quests.hint: The passage is about the specific copyright questions around AI music, not AI's music industry impact broadly.
quests.explanation: The passage explains the specific copyright questions of AI-made music, which the correct title names; the general AI music impact option is too broad.
quests.whyThisTitle: This title best summarizes the main idea.

quests.passage: Fashion, music, and television repeatedly circle back to styles from twenty or thirty years earlier, a pattern consistent enough that some cultural analysts describe it as a predictable generational cycle rather than mere coincidence. One common explanation suggests that a generation reaching adulthood begins revisiting the media of their own childhood with newly acquired purchasing power and creative influence. Companies capitalize on this pattern deliberately, reviving old franchises specifically timed to reach an audience now nostalgic for their own formative years. Recognizing this cycle helps explain why certain aesthetics seem to resurface with almost predictable regularity across entertainment and fashion alike.
options: The History of Popular Culture
The General Power of Nostalgia in Marketing
Why Pop Culture Keeps Reviving Past Decades
How Fashion Trends Are Forecasted
quests.correctAnswer: Why Pop Culture Keeps Reviving Past Decades
quests.hint: The passage is about the specific cyclical pattern of pop culture revivals, not nostalgia marketing broadly.
quests.explanation: The passage explains the specific cycle of pop culture revivals, which the correct title names; the general nostalgia marketing option is too broad.
quests.whyThisTitle: This title best summarizes the main idea.
